messages:
maria: quick q — before i draft the spec: can we agree a span name + attribute contract for all LLM requests so Console dashboards + routing policies can reliably index latency, token-usage and kvcache hits?

samir: +1 we need something compact and predictable. prefer prefix 'llm.' so queries and dashboards group naturally. e.g. `llm.request` as the root span name.

alex: suggested attributes (low-cardinality first): `llm.model.name`, `llm.model.variant`, `llm.request.type` (chat|completion|embed), `llm.route` (fast|fallback|canary), `llm.quota.bucket`. token attrs: `llm.tokens.prompt`, `llm.tokens.completion`, `llm.tokens.total`. kvcache: `llm.kv_cache.hit` (bool).

leah: please, DO NOT include prompt text or any user PII in attributes. token counts only. also include `llm.rollout.id` and `llm.rollout.phase` for canary correlation.

derek: on exporter/sampling side: we should sample full payload traces when `llm.route==\"canary\" or llm.quota.bucket==\"enterprise\"`. default sampling 0.1. also add per-attr export gating to avoid high-cardinality attributes leaking into DB.

maria: for Console mapping: latency metric = span.duration where span.name==\"llm.request\", group by `llm.model.name` + `llm.route`. cost estimate = `llm.tokens.total * model.unit_cost` (unit_cost maintained in product catalog).

samir: agree. also we should standardize kv cache attrs: `llm.kv_cache.hit` (bool) and optional `llm.kv_cache.type` (prefix|session). explicitly forbid exporting `llm.kv_cache.key` or any key identifier.

alex: small proposal block for the spec: 
```
span.name = "llm.request"
attributes: 
  llm.model.name: "gpt-4o-mini"
  llm.model.variant: "q8_0"
  llm.request.type: "chat"
  llm.route: "fast-path"
  llm.kv_cache.hit: true
  llm.tokens.prompt: 84
  llm.tokens.completion: 120
  llm.tokens.total: 204
  llm.quota.bucket: "standard"
  llm.rollout.id: "r-2026-03-01"
```

leah: on naming style — use dotted attrs `llm.x.y` to follow OTEL semantic conventions and make query grouping easier. avoid camelCase.

derek: retention policy idea: full detailed traces (sampled) kept 90 days; aggregated span metrics retained 365 days; high-cardinality attribute exports (rollout.id, model.variant) only when sampling policy triggers.

maria: nice. UX note for Rollouts/Console: we'd like a per-rollout cohort toggle in the UI that filters traces by `llm.rollout.id` and highlights token-cost deltas. can we ensure `llm.rollout.id` is attached at request entry so it's present on all spans?

samir: yes, attach at the root span when request enters router. also add `llm.route_decision` attribute for why a route was chosen (quota, latency, region). short strings only.

alex: implementer checklist: 
- update tracer lib to set `span.name = \"llm.request\"` for all inference RPCs
- emit the canonical attr set, counts only for tokens
- enforce export gating in exporter config (no high-cardinality attr to metrics unless sampled)
- add sampling rule for canaries + enterprise buckets

maria: action items: i'll open a draft PR with the spec + example telemetry YAML and a Console dashboard mapping. @derek can you add sampling rules to the exporter repo? @leah can you draft the Console cohort filter mock?

deploy-bot: scheduled job: telemetry-lint run on branch 'maria/llm-span-spec' queued.

leah: one more: telemetry-lint should flag any span that sets `llm.prompt.*` or `llm.input_text` — we want counts but never raw input.

maria: great call. ok i'll draft the doc and ping infra for a quick review. thanks all :thumbsup:
